label: Member not found
description: The service does not recognise the member the coverage names. This is a finding about the test data, not about the environment. It models DTR 2.0.1, whose operation answers a failure with an OperationOutcome. The CRD sentinel member ID P32H-NOMEM selects it too, so a case means the same thing in CRD and in DTR.
basis: Synthetic. Shaped to DTR 2.0.1, the version this tool is held to, from the guide's own examples where it has them, with this project's placeholders for every value the guide leaves open. It has not been observed from the live service.
assumption: How the live service signals an unknown member is not known. This file models an HTTP 404 carrying a FHIR OperationOutcome whose issue code is not-found and whose expression names the beneficiary of the coverage.

details.text: No member matches the coverage supplied.

issue.diagnostics: No member matches the coverage supplied.
